description: Fork of exp402 with soft_topk_n_alt='nap' — each module sets n_alternatives = its NAP (full 1-bit-flip Hamming ball). qkv/residual use 7 rows (NAP=6), v_lut/out_proj use 9 rows (NAP=8). Tests whether the remaining +0.019 gap of exp402 (vs full-soft exp365) came from the omitted 1-bit-flip neighbors (5 of 8 for NAP=8) or from the omitted 2+ bit-flip rows. If exp403 ≈ exp365 → 1-bit-flip ball is sufficient. If exp403 still ~+0.01-0.02 behind → some quality comes from 2+ bit flips. NOTE: backward is ~3× slower than full soft (benchmark: 25 ms vs 8.6 ms at out_proj shape) — this is a QUALITY isolation experiment, not a speed win.
